facts.fact: Statistics Botswana says the National Identification System assigns a unique birth registration number to every citizen child at birth, which becomes the Omang number at 16.
Statistics Botswana says the number is assigned to every citizen child at birth, with registration through 35 district offices and 17 on-site points, introduced in 2003.

BWA.note: No statement on who operates or owns the system.

facts.fact: Statistics Botswana says the National Identification System assigns a unique number to every citizen child at birth, which becomes the national identity (Omang) number at age 16.
